title: 春晓
author: Meng Haoran

translation: In spring, I sleep so deeply I don't notice the dawn
Last night, I heard the sound of wind and rain

annotations.春眠: spring sleep — the drowsiness of spring
annotations.不觉晓: don't notice the morning — sleeping late

appreciation: This poem beautifully captures the feeling of a spring morning. The poet sleeps contentedly through the night, unaware of dawn, until the birdsong outside alerts him to the morning. A hint of concern for the flowers that may have been damaged by last night's storm adds a touch of melancholy to the otherwise peaceful scene.
